summary: The filing is a routine 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that the Canadian Intellectual Property Office issued a Notice of Allowance for a patent covering Reqorsa Gene Therapy in combination with PD-1/PD-L1 antibodies for lung cancer. It is not a special situation; it is a standard IP milestone press release with no transaction, board action, or structural event. The company announces no deal terms, no financial instruments, no activist involvement, and no governance change. This is an ordinary business update with forward-looking cautionary language.
